subject: FluxForge x Redwood — co-marketing & event activation roadmap
messages:
From: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@leadwell.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: partnerships@fluxforge.com
Date: Sun, 17 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Partner activation idea — FluxForge + Redwood joint content + demo series

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the intro call last week — excited about the potential overlap between FluxForge's model debugging toolkit and Redwood's inference runtime. Leadwell spoke with FluxForge and they asked whether we could stand up a short co-marketing program this summer: 1) a 45-minute joint webinar (tech demo + Q&A), 2) a short blog swap (guest post + cross-promo), and 3) sponsored presence at DevSummit in August (small booth + lightning talk).

High level asks from their side:
- Redwood to provide a technical demo focused on low-latency inference and KV cache optimizations for multi-tenant ISVs
- FluxForge to provide their regression-detection case study (prepped slides)
- Joint registration page and shared promotional calendar

Can you confirm interest and any constraints (budget for booth, approvals needed, or dates to avoid)? We can draft a mutual action plan if you’re interested.

Best,
Sarah
Leadwell Consulting (on behalf of FluxForge)
[Attachment: FluxForge-proposal-summary.pdf (PDF, 78KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@leadwell.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, partnerships@fluxforge.com
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partner activation idea — FluxForge + Redwood joint content + demo series

Sarah — thanks for the clear rundown. We’re very interested. Quick notes from Redwood:

- Webinar: yes, 45 minutes works. Proposed format — 20m Redwood demo (runtime optimizations + quantization callouts), 15m FluxForge case study, 10m live Q&A.
- Blog swap: happy to do an engineer-level guest post and an ops-oriented post from FluxForge.
- DevSummit sponsorship: we need to know FluxForge sponsor level (booth vs table) — Redwood has limited booth budget this quarter but can support a shared tabletop and a lightning talk slot.

I’ll start a mutual action plan doc and a draft agenda — attaching a preliminary deck and a one-pager with suggested roles. Jonas, Ben — flagged for logistics and field marketing support.

Thanks,
Marissa
Director, Alliances | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: co-marketing-deck-v1.pptx (PPTX, 2.1MB)]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Sarah Nguyen <sarah@leadwell.com>
Cc: partnerships@fluxforge.com
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partner activation idea — FluxForge + Redwood joint content + demo series

Marissa / Sarah — quick logistics from field:

- Webinar dates: we have open windows week of July 20 or Aug 3. Prefer July 20 to avoid DevSummit week prep.
- Promo: Redwood can commit to 3 email blasts (announce, reminder, last-chance) and social amplification. Need final copy by July 6.
- DevSummit: market is tight — FluxForge should confirm sponsor package by June 1. If they secure sponsor booth, Redwood can co-staff for half-day coverage. Our sponsorship budget can cover a shared table and sponsorship listing.

Ben — can you confirm whether we can get a booth credit or apply partnership funds to the table? Also attaching a suggested draft agenda for your review.

-Jonas
Sr. Field Marketing Manager
[Attachment: draft_agenda.pdf (PDF, 24KB)]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sarah Nguyen <sarah@leadwell.com>
Cc: partnerships@fluxforge.com
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partner activation idea — FluxForge + Redwood joint content + demo series

All — confirmed with finance: we have a $6k partner co-marketing pool for Q2 that can be applied toward DevSummit tabletop or paid promotion. If FluxForge needs a booth (higher tiers), we’ll need a co-sponsor contribution — suggest we ask FluxForge for their preferred level and whether they can cover incremental costs.

Action items I’ll take:
- Draft sponsor cost split options and upload the sponsor-level-pricing.xlsx by EOD.
- Coordinate with ops on webinar host (Zoom + registration) and request recording & transcript.

Sarah — can FluxForge/Leadwell confirm which booth level they prefer and whether they can commit to a shared staffing plan?

Thanks,
Ben
Head of Field Marketing

From: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@leadwell.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Partner activation idea — FluxForge + Redwood joint content + demo series

Thanks — all sounds good. FluxForge confirms they’ll take tabletop sponsor (shared booth) and will contribute $2k toward sponsorship costs. They prefer the July 20 webinar date.

Next steps we can take now:
- Marissa/Jonas: finalize webinar outline and publish registration page (I can help wire copy).
- Ben: upload sponsor split worksheet and finalize billing contacts.
- FluxForge: share their case study slides and short bio for the lightning talk.

I attached the FluxForge case study slides and a draft summary of the joint promotion cadence. Once you confirm the timeline I’ll put it into the mutual action plan.

—Sarah
Leadwell Consulting (on behalf of FluxForge)
